74.name: Acetoacetyl-CoA
74.description: Acetoacetyl CoA is the precursor of HMG-CoA in the mevalonate pathway, which is essential for cholesterol biosynthesis.

586.name: Creatine
586.description: Creatine is an organic compound that facilitates recycling of adenosine triphosphate in vertebrates, primarily in their muscle and brain tissue.

970.name: Oxaloacetic acid
970.description: Oxaloacetic acid is a crystalline organic compound with the chemical formula HO2CC CH2CO2H.

1354.name: Chlorophenylbiguanide
1354.description: meta-Chlorophenylbiguanide (1- is an allosteric agonist and modulator of the 5-HT3 receptor and an antagonist of the α2A-adrenergic receptor.

1738.name: Homovanillic acid
1738.description: Homovanillic acid is a major catecholamine metabolite that is produced by a consecutive action of monoamine oxidase and catechol-O-methyltransferase on dopamine.

2378.name: Bifonazole
2378.description: Bifonazole is an imidazole antifungal drug used in form of ointments.

2762.name: Cinoxacin
2762.description: Cinoxacin is a quinolone antibiotic that has been discontinued in the U.K.

2890.name: CX-546
2890.description: CX-546 is an ampakine drug developed by Cortex Pharmaceuticals.

3658.name: Hydroxyzine
3658.description: Hydroxyzine, sold under the brand names Atarax and Vistaril among others, is an antihistamine medication.

4170.name: Metolazone
4170.description: Metolazone is a thiazide-like diuretic marketed under the brand names Zytanix, Metoz, Zaroxolyn, and Mykrox.

4810.name: Moxonidine
4810.description: Moxonidine is an imidazoline receptor agonist antihypertensive drug licensed for the treatment of mild to moderate essential hypertension.

4938.name: Propentofylline
4938.description: Propentofylline is a xanthine derivative drug with purported neuroprotective effects.

5322.name: Sulfacytine
5322.description: Sulfacytine is a short-acting sulfonamide antibiotic, taken orally for treatment against bacterial infections.

5578.name: Trimethoprim
5578.description: Trimethoprim is an antibiotic used mainly in the treatment of bladder infections.

5706.name: Xylamine
5706.description: Xylamine is a monoaminergic neurotoxin and benzylamine derivative that is closely related to DSP-4.

5834.name: Prednisolone acetate
5834.description: Prednisolone acetate is a synthetic glucocorticoid corticosteroid and a corticosteroid ester. It is the 21-acetate ester of prednisolone.

6090.name: Diethyltryptamine
6090.description: Diethyltryptamine , also known as N,N-diethyltryptamine or T-9, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family closely related to dimethyltryptamine .

6346.name: Diiodomethane
6346.description: Diiodomethane or methylene iodide, commonly abbreviated "MI", is an organoiodine compound.

6858.name: 3,4,5-Trimethoxybenzaldehyde
6858.description: 3,4,5-Trimethoxybenzaldehyde is an organic compound and a biochemical. Within this class of compounds, the chemical is categorized as a trisubstituted aromatic aldehyde.

7114.name: 4-Nitrobiphenyl
7114.description: 4-Nitrobiphenyl is an organic compound with the formula C6H5−C6H4NO2.

7242.name: O-Toluidine
7242.description: o-Toluidine is an organic compound with the chemical formula CH3C6H4NH2.

7498.name: Benzyl bromide
7498.description: Benzyl bromide is an organic compound with the formula C7H7Br or C6H5CH2Br.

7882.name: N-Methyltaurine
7882.description: N-Methyltaurine is an aminosulfonic acid which is present as a zwitterion in the crystalline state and in polar solvents .

8010.name: Malononitrile
8010.description: Malononitrile is an organic compound nitrile with the formula CH2 2.

8266.name: Chlorendic acid
8266.description: Chlorendic acid, or 1,4,5,6,7,7-hexachlorobicyclo[2.2.1]-hept-5-ene-2,3-dicarboxylic acid, is a chlorinated carboxylic acid used in the synthesis of some flame retardants and polymers.

8522.name: Iodoantipyrine
8522.description: Iodoantipyrine is a drug developed in the 1950s.

9034.name: Methohexital
9034.description: Methohexital or methohexitone (marketed under the brand names Brevital and Brietal) is a barbiturate derivative.

9162.name: Picene
9162.description: Picene is a hydrocarbon found in the pitchy residue obtained in the distillation of peat tar and of petroleum.

9290.name: Calcium gluconate
9290.description: Calcium gluconate is the calcium salt of gluconic acid and is used as a mineral supplement and medication.

10314.name: Conhydrine
10314.description: Conhydrine is a poisonous alkaloid found in poison hemlock in small quantities.

10442.name: 1,3-Propanediol
10442.description: 1,3-Propanediol is the organic compound with the formula CH2 2.

10698.name: Mesitol
10698.description: Mesitol is an organic compound with the formula 3C6H2OH. It is one of several isomers of trimethylphenol. The name and structure of mesitol derives from the combination of mesitylene and phenol.

10826.name: Cerium(III) acetate
10826.description: Cerium acetate is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula of Ce 3.

11082.name: 6-APA
11082.description: 6-APA ( -6-aminopenicillanic acid) is an organic compound that is used in the synthesis of β–lactam antibiotics including amoxicillin, ampicillin, oxacillin, and carbenicillin.

11210.name: Neohexene
11210.description: Neohexene is the hydrocarbon compound with the chemical formula 3CCH=CH2. It is a colorless liquid, with properties similar to other hexenes. It is a precursor to commercial synthetic musk perfumes.

11594.name: 2-Methylheptane
11594.description: 2-Methylheptane is a branched-chain alkane and an isomer of octane.

11722.name: Methyl carbamate
11722.description: Methyl carbamate (also called methylurethane, or urethylane) is an organic compound and the simplest ester of carbamic acid .

11850.name: Galactitol
11850.description: Galactitol is a sugar alcohol, the reduction product of galactose.

11978.name: 5-Methylindole
11978.description: 5-Methylindole is an irritating organic compound with chemical formula C9H9N.

13514.name: 1,1,1-Trichloroacetone
13514.description: 1,1,1-Trichloroacetone is a chlorinated analogue of acetone with the chemical formula CH3COCCl3.

14410.name: Decabromodiphenyl ether
14410.description: Decabromodiphenyl ether (also referred to as decaBDE, DBDE, BDE-209) is a brominated flame retardant which belongs to the group of polybrominated diphenyl ethers .

14794.name: Antimony trioxide
14794.description: Antimony oxide is the inorganic compound with the formula Sb2O3.

15818.name: 3α-Androstanediol
15818.description: 3α-Androstanediol also known as 5α-androstane-3α,17β-diol and sometimes shortened in the literature to 3α-diol, is an endogenous steroid hormone and neurosteroid and a metabolite of androgens like...

19274.name: Cetadiol
19274.description: Cetadiol, also known as androst-5-ene-3β,16α-diol, is a drug described as a "steroid tranquilizer" which was briefly investigated as a treatment for alcoholism in the 1950s.

19402.name: Chlorophacinone
19402.description: Chlorophacinone is a first-generation anticoagulant rodenticide.

20810.name: Acetryptine
20810.description: Acetryptine (INN; developmental code W-2965-A; also known as 5-acetyltryptamine or 5-AT) is a drug described as an antihypertensive agent which was never marketed.

21322.name: Benzadox
21322.description: Benzadox is an amide herbicide, first discovered in 1966 to control kochia on sugarbeet crops.

21706.name: Ap4A
21706.description: Diadenosine tetraphosphate or Ap4A is a putative alarmone, ubiquitous in nature being common to everything from bacteria to humans.

24010.name: Antimony(III) sulfate
24010.description: Antimony sulfate, Sb2 3, is a hygroscopic salt formed by reacting antimony or its compounds with hot sulfuric acid.

24266.name: Sodium monofluorophosphate
24266.description: Sodium monofluorophosphate, commonly abbreviated SMFP, is an inorganic fluorophosphate with the chemical formula Na2PO3F.

24394.name: Tantalum(V) chloride
24394.description: Tantalum chloride, also known as tantalum pentachloride, is an inorganic compound with the formula TaCl5.

38346.name: Nilestriol

43082.name: Setastine
43082.description: Setastine is an antihistamine used to treat allergies and rhinitis.

43594.name: Cefonicid
43594.description: Cefonicide is a cephalosporin antibiotic. It has a density of 1.92g/cm3.

49354.name: Pentomone

55754.name: Ofornine
55754.description: Ofornine is a synthetic compound investigated primarily for its antihypertensive properties.

60490.name: Zileuton
60490.description: Zileuton is an orally active inhibitor of 5-lipoxygenase, and thus inhibits leukotrienes formation, used for the maintenance treatment of asthma.

61002.name: Phenicarbazide
61002.description: Phenicarbazide is a semicarbazide and an antipyretic substance. It is carcinogenic in mice.

61130.name: Myrtenal
61130.description: Myrtenal is a bicyclic monoterpenoid with the chemical formula C10H14O.

61258.name: Lead stearate
61258.description: Lead stearate is a metal-organic compound, a salt of lead and stearic acid with the chemical formula Pb 2.

62666.name: Silver chromate
62666.description: Silver chromate is an inorganic compound with formula Ag2CrO4 which appears as distinctively coloured brown-red crystals.

64970.name: 18-Hydroxy-11-deoxycorticosterone
64970.description: 18-Hydroxy-11-deoxycorticosterone (also known as 18-OH-DOC, 18,21-dihydroxyprogesterone, and 18,21-dihydroxypregn-4-ene-3,20-dione) is an endogenous steroid and a mineralocorticoid.

65098.name: Norvaline
65098.description: Norvaline is an amino acid with the formula CH3 2CH CO2H.

66890.name: Sulfaclozine
66890.description: Sulfaclozine is a sulfonamide antimicrobial medication used in veterinary medicine.

68682.name: Arbekacin
68682.description: Arbekacin is a semisynthetic aminoglycoside antibiotic which was derived from kanamycin.

71754.name: Denopamine
71754.description: Denopamine is a drug which acts as a β1 adrenergic receptor agonist.

72138.name: Tolonidine
72138.description: Tolonidine is an antihypertensive. It is an imidazoline receptor agonist, like moxonidine and rilmenidine.

72394.name: Lividomycin
72394.description: Lividomycin is a broad-spectrum aminoglycoside antibiotic. It is effective against most Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria including Mycobacterium tuberculosis and Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

72906.name: Tetraphenyllead
72906.description: Tetraphenyllead is an organolead compound with the chemical formula Pb 4 or PbPh4. It is a white solid.

77898.name: Sulfonyl diisocyanate
77898.description: Sulfonyl diisocyanate is an organic chemical compound of carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, and sulphur with the molecular formula C2N2O4S.

82250.name: Manganese(II) iodide
82250.description: Manganese iodide is the chemical compound composed of manganese and iodide with the formula MnI2 n.

89034.name: Methionine sulfoximine
89034.description: Methionine sulfoximine is an irreversible glutamine synthetase inhibitor.

90570.name: Vanadium nitride
90570.description: Vanadium nitride, VN, is a chemical compound of vanadium and nitrogen.

91466.name: Matrine
91466.description: Matrine is an alkaloid found in plants from the family Fabaceae.

92746.name: Zymosterol
92746.description: Zymosterol is an intermediate in cholesterol biosynthesis.

92874.name: Levoverbenone
92874.description: Levoverbenone is an expectorant. It is the -isomer of verbenone.

93514.name: Metazosin
93514.description: Metazosin is an antihypertensive α1-adrenergic receptor antagonist.

94154.name: Arabitol
94154.description: Arabitol, or arabinitol, is a sugar alcohol.

95562.name: Hydroxyaminovaleric acid
95562.description: Hydroxyaminovaleric acid is the organic compound with the formula HOCH2 3CH CO2H.

101706.name: Doisynolic acid
101706.description: Doisynolic acid is a synthetic, orally active, nonsteroidal estrogen that was never marketed.

104778.name: Carbidopa/levodopa
104778.description: Carbidopa/levodopa, sold under the brand name Sinemet among others, is a fixed-dose combination used for the treatment of Parkinson's disease.

107722.name: 7α-Hydroxycholesterol
107722.description: 7α-Hydroxycholesterol is a precursor of bile acids, created by cholesterol 7α-hydroxylase . Its formation is the rate-determining step in bile acid synthesis.

119114.name: Teniloxazine
119114.description: Teniloxazine , also known as sufoxazine and sulfoxazine, is a drug which is marketed in Japan.

126154.name: Cyclic glycine-proline
126154.description: Cyclic glycine-proline is a small neuroactive peptide that belongs to a group of bioactive 2,5-diketopiperazines and is also known as cyclo-glycine-proline.

136138.name: Silabenzene
136138.description: A silabenzene is a heteroaromatic compound containing one or more silicon atoms instead of carbon atoms in benzene.

138570.name: 1,2-Dioxane
138570.description: 1,2-Dioxane or o-dioxane is an organic compound with the molecular formula 4O2, classified as a cyclic peroxide.

140746.name: Ethanimine
140746.description: Ethanimine is an organonitrogen compound classified as an imine.

150986.name: 4-Androstene-3,6,17-trione
150986.description: 4-Androstene-3,6,17-trione (4-AT; also marketed as 6-OXO or 4-etioallocholen-3,6,17-trione) is a drug or nutritional supplement that may increase the testosterone-estrogen ratio, but has no proven...

159690.name: Thallium(III) nitrate
159690.description: Thallium nitrate, also known as thallic nitrate, is a thallium compound with chemical formula Tl 3.

160586.name: Deuterated dichloromethane
160586.description: Deuterated dichloromethane is a form of dichloromethane in which the hydrogen atoms are deuterium .

160714.name: WIN-2299
160714.description: WIN-2299 is an anticholinergic drug. Human reactions to WIN-2299 include sedation , LSD-like reactions , and an acute delirious episode .

164682.name: 5-Fluorotryptamine
164682.description: 5-Fluorotryptamine (5-fluoro-T, 5-FT, or 5-F-T; code name PAL-284) is a serotonin receptor agonist and monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine family.

170058.name: Copper(II) tetrafluoroborate
170058.description: Copper tetrafluoroborate or cupric tetrafluoroborate is any inorganic compound with the formula Cu x 2.

195658.name: PIM-35
195658.description: PIM-35, also known as 5-methoxyindolyl-2-methylamine, is a drug which is an indole derivative with a similar chemical structure to that of serotonin.

197706.name: Donitriptan
197706.description: Donitriptan (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name; developmental code name F-11356) is a triptan drug which was investigated as an antimigraine agent but was never marketed.

198346.name: L-Arginine L-pyroglutamate
198346.description: l-Arginine l-pyroglutamate, also known as pirglutargine and arginine pidolate, is the l-arginine salt of pyroglutamic acid. Arginine pyroglutamate is a delivery form of arginine.

206666.name: Diphenidine

207306.name: Selenocystine
207306.description: Selenocystine is the amino acid with the formula (HO2CCH CH2Se)2.

214346.name: Coluracetam
214346.description: Coluracetam (INN; development code BCI-540; formerly MKC-231) is a purported nootropic agent of the racetam family.

234570.name: Pseudomorphine
234570.description: Pseudomorphine (also known as oxydimorphine or dehydromorphine) is an inactive, natural dimerisation product of the morphine molecule in tandem and thus a common impurity in morphine concentrations.

263626.name: Trimethylthiazoline
263626.description: Trimethylthiazoline is a constituent of fox urine and feces that may be an innately aversive odor to rodents.

357194.name: Adozelesin
357194.description: Adozelesin is an experimental antitumor drug of the duocarmycin class.

439242.name: Raffinose
439242.description: Raffinose is a trisaccharide derived from galactose, glucose, and fructose.

441034.name: Idose
441034.description: Idose is a hexose, a six carbon monosaccharide.

454858.name: Racivir
454858.description: Racivir is an experimental nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor , developed by Pharmasset for the treatment of HIV.

667594.name: SB-366791
667594.description: SB-366791 is a drug which acts as a potent and selective blocker of the TRPV1 ion channel. It has analgesic effects in animal studies, and is used in research into pain and inflammation.

671690.name: Bemesetron
671690.description: Bemesetron is a drug which acts as an antagonist at the 5HT3 receptor.

2724682.name: Lithium diisopropylamide
2724682.description: Lithium diisopropylamide is a chemical compound with the molecular formula LiN(CH 2)2.

3035850.name: Namodenoson
3035850.description: Namodenoson is a small molecule A3 adenosine receptor agonist. It is developed by Can-Fite for non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, liver cancer, and pancreatic cancer.

3080650.name: Tuinal
3080650.description: Tuinal was the brand name of a discontinued combination drug composed of two barbiturate sodium salts in equal proportions.

3081930.name: Curzerenone
3081930.description: Curzerenone is an antimicrobial isolate of Lindera pulcherrima.

5107658.name: Sodium perrhenate
5107658.description: Sodium perrhenate (also known as sodium rhenate ) is the inorganic compound with the formula NaReO4.

5280458.name: Psychosine
5280458.description: Psychosine is a highly cytotoxic lipid that accumulates in the nervous system in the absence of galactosylceramidase and has been associated with Krabbe disease.

5281226.name: Bixin
5281226.description: Bixin is an apocarotenoid found in the seeds of the achiote tree from which it derives its name.

5282506.name: Ascorbyl palmitate
5282506.description: Ascorbyl palmitate is an ester formed from ascorbic acid and palmitic acid creating a fat-soluble form of vitamin C.

5329098.name: Semaxanib
5329098.description: Semaxanib is a tyrosine-kinase inhibitor drug designed by SUGEN as a cancer therapeutic.

5363146.name: Diisopropyl azodicarboxylate
5363146.description: Diisopropyl azodicarboxylate is the diisopropyl ester of azodicarboxylic acid.

5460042.name: Salutaridinol
5460042.description: Salutaridinol is a modified benzyltetrahydroisoquinoline alkaloid with the formula C19H23NO4.

6078282.name: Combretastatin A-1
6078282.description: Combretastatin A-1 is a combretastatin and a stilbenoid. It can be found in Combretum afrum, the Eastern Cape South African Bushwillow tree.

6432458.name: Brassicasterol
6432458.description: Brassicasterol is a 28-carbon sterol synthesised by several unicellular algae and some terrestrial plants, like rape.

6857674.name: Pyrosilicate
6857674.description: A pyrosilicate is a type of chemical compound; either an ionic compound that contains the pyrosilicate anion Si2O6−7, or an organic compound with the hexavalent ≡O3Si−O−SiO3≡ group.

6913994.name: Fostriecin
6913994.description: Fostriecin is a type I polyketide synthase derived natural product, originally isolated from the soil bacterium Streptomyces pulveraceus.

9571018.name: Lithol Rubine BK
9571018.description: Lithol Rubine BK is a reddish synthetic azo dye.

9804490.name: AH-1058
9804490.description: AH-1058 is a lipophilic antiarrhythmic calcium channel blocker synthesized by the Pharmaceutical Research Laboratories of Ajinomoto Co., Inc in Kawasaki, Japan.

9820874.name: CP-615,003
9820874.description: CP-615,003 is a drug which acts as a subtype-selective partial agonist at GABAA receptors, and was developed by Pfizer as a potential anxiolytic; however, poor blood–brain barrier penetration make it...

9839306.name: Prallethrin
9839306.description: Prallethrin is a pyrethroid insecticide and mosquito repellent.

9852746.name: Paliperidone palmitate
9852746.description: Paliperidone palmitate , sold under the brand names Invega Sustenna, Xeplion, Shansida , Erzofri and Psokadron for the once‑monthly formulation, and as Invega Trinza/Trevicta and Invega...
synonyms: Invega Hafyera, Invega Sustenna, Invega Trinza, others

9949130.name: LY-301317

10037962.name: WAY-470
10037962.description: WAY-470 is a drug which acts as an agonist at 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptors though with lower affinity at 5-HT2B.

10072906.name: Fluazacort
10072906.description: Fluazacort is a synthetic glucocorticoid corticosteroid which is marketed in Italy.

10077130.name: Vorapaxar
10077130.description: Vorapaxar (brand name Zontivity, formerly known as SCH 530348) is a thrombin receptor antagonist based on the natural product himbacine, discovered by Schering-Plough and developed by Merck & Co.

10447050.name: 1,7-Bis(4-hydroxyphenyl)-1,4,6-heptatrien-3-one
10447050.description: 1,7-Bis -1,4,6-heptatrien-3-one is a natural product, a curcuminoid antioxidant found in turmeric and torch ginger .

10534218.name: Perimycin
10534218.description: Perimycin, also known as aminomycin and fungimycin, is polyene antibiotic produced by Streptomyces coelicolor var. aminophilus. The compound exhibits antifungal properties.

10942026.name: Dicarbonyltris(triphenylphosphine)ruthenium(0)
10942026.description: Dicarbonyltris ruthenium or Roper's complex is a ruthenium metal carbonyl.

11321546.name: Ammonium hexafluorotitanate
11321546.description: Ammonium hexafluorotitanate is the inorganic compound with the chemical formula 2[TiF6]. A colorless salt, the compound consists of ammonium ions and the hexafluorotitanate dianion.

11418570.name: Magnesium gluconate
11418570.description: Magnesium gluconate is a compound with formula Mg 2.

11561674.name: Apremilast
11561674.description: Apremilast, sold under the brand name Otezla among others, is a medication for the treatment of certain types of psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis.

11740874.name: Algestone acetonide
11740874.description: Algestone acetonide , also known as algestone 16α,17α-acetonide or 16α,17α-isopropylidenedioxyprogesterone, is a progestin which was never marketed.

12305738.name: Prismane
12305738.description: Prismane or Ladenburg benzene is a polycyclic hydrocarbon with the formula C6H6.

13518666.name: 3,4-Dihydroxymethcathinone
13518666.description: 3,4-Dihydroxymethcathinone , or 3,4-dihydroxy-N-methylcathinone, is a monoamine releasing agent of the amphetamine and cathinone families.

16132042.name: Alamethicin
16132042.description: Alamethicin is a channel-forming peptide antibiotic, produced by the fungus Trichoderma viride.

16219978.name: Syringomycin E
16219978.description: Syringomycin E is a member of a class of lipodepsinonapeptide molecules that are secreted by the plant pathogen Pseudomonas syringae.

16682954.name: Diisobutylaluminium hydride
16682954.description: Diisobutylaluminium hydride is a reducing agent with the formula 2, where i-Bu represents isobutyl (-CH2CH 2). This organoaluminium compound is a reagent in organic synthesis.

19363402.name: JTE 7-31
19363402.description: JTE 7-31 is a selective cannabinoid receptor agonist invented by Japan Tobacco.

20684874.name: Isodiazomethane
20684874.description: In organic chemistry, isodiazomethane, also known as isocyanamide, aminoisonitrile, or systematically as isocyanoamine, is the parent compound of a class of derivatives of general formula R2N–NC.

21538250.name: Silicon monosulfide
21538250.description: Silicon monosulfide is a chemical compound of silicon and sulfur.

23670858.name: Potassium aluminate
23670858.description: Potassium aluminate is an inorganic compound with the empirical formula KAlO2, composed of the potassium cation and the AlO−2 aluminate anion, which in aqueous solution exists as K[Al 4].

23757258.name: 7-Hydroxy-DMT
23757258.description: 7-Hydroxy-DMT , also known as 7-hydroxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the tryptamine family related to dimethyltryptamine .

44719562.name: EME (drug)
44719562.description: EME, also known as 2,5-diethoxy-4-methoxyamphetamine or as TMA2-2,5-DiEtO, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families related to the psychedelic drug TMA-2.

53258570.name: Fotagliptin
53258570.description: Fotagliptin is a DPP-4 inhibitor under development for the treatment of type 2 diabetes.

53341130.name: MK-4409

54604362.name: Europium(III) nitrate
54604362.description: Europium nitrate is an inorganic compound with the formula Eu 3·x . The hexahydrate is a common salt. It forms colorless hygroscopic crystals.

56842186.name: Holothurin
56842186.description: The holothurins are a group of toxins originally isolated from the sea cucumber Actinopyga agassizii.

59048650.name: Tetramethylethylenediamine(dimethyl)nickel(II)
59048650.description: Tetramethylethylenediamine nickel is the organonickel complex with the formula NiMe2 .

59691338.name: MK-4541
59691338.description: MK-4541 is a dual selective androgen receptor modulator and 5α-reductase inhibitor which has been of interest for the potential treatment of prostate cancer but has not been marketed at this time.

71308234.name: Malvidin-3-O-(6-p-coumaroyl)glucoside
71308234.description: Malvidin-3-O- glucoside is a p-coumaroylated anthocyanin found in grape and wine. There are two forms with the cis and trans isomers of p-coumaric acid. It is a cation.

71355210.name: MgCu2
71355210.description: MgCu2 is a binary intermetallic compound of magnesium and copper adopting cubic crystal structure, more specifically the C15 Laves phase.

72710730.name: Pseudopterosin E
72710730.description: Pseudopterosin E is an anti-inflammatory isolate from the Caribbean coral Pseudopterogorgia elisabethae.

75593290.name: Desidustat
75593290.description: Desidustat is a drug for the treatment of anemia of chronic kidney disease. This drug with the brand name Oxemia is discovered and developed by Zydus Life Sciences.

92025674.name: Tellurium monoiodide
92025674.description: Tellurium iodide is an inorganic compound with the formula TeI.

100989770.name: Habenariol
